theme.description: Cyber-Premium. A high-end 'Command Center' aesthetic. Deep matte black surfaces cut by laser-precise neon accents. It feels expensive, highly technical, and built for speed. No generic 'Vercel' look.

rules: No pure #000000. Base is slightly tinted with blue/purple #050505.
Neon colors (Cyan, Volt Yellow) are used ONLY for critical data, interactions, or 'Tracing Beam' borders. Never as large background fills.
Gradients are strictly prohibited for backgrounds. Use pure matte surfaces.

hierarchy.overline: text-xs font-bold tracking-[0.2em] uppercase text-accent-secondary font-mono

rules: Never use Inter, Roboto, or standard sans for headings. Unbounded gives the futuristic/technical vibe.
Use JetBrains Mono for ALL monetary values, IMEI numbers, barcodes, and technical specs.
Always apply tracking-tighter to Unbounded headings > 32px.

landing_page.spacing: Generous (gap-8 to gap-16, py-24 to py-32)
landing_page.alignment: Aggressive asymmetry. Overlap images with text blocks.

dashboard.spacing: Tight, dense (gap-4, p-4 or p-6 per card)
dashboard.alignment: Strict geometric alignment. Every pixel utilized. No jagged bottoms.

rules: Use subgrid where necessary to align inner elements of cards.
Padding inside bordered containers must be generous enough (p-6) to prevent text collision.

buttons.primary: bg-accent-primary text-black font-bold uppercase tracking-wide rounded-none border border-accent-primary hover:bg-accent-primary_hover transition-colors shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(0,240,255,0.3)]
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent text-primary font-bold border border-border rounded-none hover:border-accent-secondary hover:text-accent-secondary transition-colors font-mono uppercase text-sm

cards.dashboard_widget: bg-surface border border-border rounded-none p-6 flex flex-col gap-4 hover:border-border/80 transition-colors
cards.pricing_tier: relative bg-surface_elevated border border-border p-8 rounded-none. The 'Pro' tier MUST feature a 'Tracing Beam' glowing border effect using framer-motion.

navigation.classes: fixed top-0 w-full z-50 backdrop-blur-xl bg-background/60 border-b border-border/50
navigation.behavior: Sticky. Must not obscure content below (ensure body has pt-20 or similar).

forms_and_inputs.classes: bg-background border-border border-b-2 border-t-0 border-l-0 border-r-0 rounded-none focus:border-accent-primary focus:ring-0 text-primary font-mono transition-colors
forms_and_inputs.labels: text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-widest text-secondary mb-2 block

tables.header: text-xs font-mono text-muted uppercase tracking-wider border-b border-border pb-4

badges.success: border border-status-success text-status-success px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase
badges.warning: border border-status-warning text-status-warning px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase
badges.error: border border-status-error text-status-error px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase

motion_and_interactions.hover: Text color changes explicitly on hover. Elements translate-y-[-2px] strictly where applicable.
motion_and_interactions.landing_animations: Use staggered fade-ins and parallax scrolling (framer-motion or similar).
motion_and_interactions.dashboard_animations: Keep it snappy. Micro-interactions only. 150ms durations.

hero_background.description: Dark abstract technology/neon structure. Use as a low-opacity, black-tinted background for the hero section.

feature_precision.description: Macro shot of a technician soldering. Use in the 'Features' or 'Why TechGarage' section on the landing page.

context_store.description: Modern sleek tech store interior. Good for the 'For Modern Repair Shops' narrative section.

rules: Hero image must have a heavy dark overlay (bg-black/70 or gradient) so the neon cyan and volt yellow text remains highly legible.
Do not use generic vector illustrations. Stick to the photography provided above.

icons.rules: Use duotone to match the 'neon/cyber' aesthetic (one layer bright, one layer dim).

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 for standard text. Text over the dark background is #FAFAFA, ensuring maximum APCA readability.
accessibility_and_testing.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a 'data-testid' attribute using kebab-case role-based naming (e.g., data-testid='submit-repair-job-btn', data-testid='revenue-kpi-value').

instructions_to_main_agent: 1. Setup Tailwind config with the exact colors and fonts provided. Do NOT use default colors like 'blue-500'.
2. Add Google Fonts: Unbounded, Manrope, JetBrains Mono.
3. Landing Page: Implement a high-impact Hero with the provided background image. Use the 'Tracing Beam' effect on the Pro Pricing card.
4. Dashboard: Create a dense, 'Control Room' grid layout. Use JetBrains Mono exclusively for all stats, IMEI, and pricing data.
5. Use Phosphor Icons (duotone weight) to complement the techy vibe.
6. Build Shadcn components but STRIP AWAY the 'Vercel-look'. Force square corners (rounded-none), pure matte backgrounds, and high-contrast borders.
7. Include robust `data-testid` tags on all actionable elements and KPI data points.
8. Ensure the transition between the Landing Page (marketing) and Dashboard (app) feels like stepping into a premium operating system.
